objective: Locate whether continuous OI best-head ranking failures arise from nuisance geometry, nonlinear feature representation, insufficient prototype topology, or score normalization.

reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen heads on observed features

oracle_semantics.observed: Rotated signal plus nuisance; the only practitioner-visible representation.
oracle_semantics.oracle_signal: The four noisy signal channels before nuisance concatenation and rotation.
oracle_semantics.oracle_sufficient: The two noisy primitive signal coordinates before redundant linear expansion.
oracle_semantics.oracle_quadratic_lift: Oracle sufficient coordinates followed by the fixed degree-2 no-bias polynomial map; no target outcomes are used by the map.

diagnostic_contrasts.prototype_topology: k8 versus k4 within observed, sufficient, and lifted views
diagnostic_contrasts.nonlinear_representation: oracle_quadratic_lift versus oracle_sufficient at matched k
diagnostic_contrasts.calibration: Spearman with the best-head envelope for final index, negative actual loss, and negative loss ratio separately

axis_metrics.quality_at_fixed_nuisance: Within each nuisance level, rank the four independent signal-quality levels; this is the primary oracle-view estimand.
axis_metrics.nuisance_at_fixed_quality: Within each signal-quality level, rank nuisance severity; undefined ties are recorded as null rather than zero.

interpretation_rules: If oracle signal improves ranking, nuisance geometry is limiting.
Oracle nuisance-free views are interpreted primarily through quality-at-fixed-nuisance metrics because they deliberately tie nuisance variants at a fixed quality.
If k8 improves a fixed oracle view, prototype coverage is limiting.
If quadratic lifting improves a fixed-k oracle view, the linear metric representation is limiting.
If negative actual loss ranks well but final index does not, null normalization is limiting.
If oracle lifted k8 remains poor, the OI overlap objective or aggregation is misaligned with the best-head envelope.
tie_rule: Average envelope performance across candidates tied at absolute tolerance 1e-12 for the maximum selector score.
scope: Mechanism diagnostic with privileged oracle views; not a deployable ranking result.
